BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE SUBODH ABHYANKAR  ON THE 21 st OF FEBRUARY, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 7179 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 HARISINGH S/O LAKSHMANSINGH YADAV, AGED  ABOUT 39 YEARS, OCCUPATION: MAZDOOR R/O  VILALGE NIPANIYA TEHSIL ALOT DISTT. RATLAM  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI NILESH JOSHI, ADVOCATE)
 AND

THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE  OFFICER THROUGH POLICE STATION ALIRAJPUR  DISTRICT ALIRAJPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY MS. HARSHALATA SONI, P.L.)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER T h is is applicant's first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.524/2021 registered at Police Station Alirajpur, District Alirajpur (MP) for offence punishable under Section 409, 420,
467, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Section 6 of Nikshepako Ki Hito Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam.

sentences.text: Allegations against the applicant is that he along with other accused persons obtained an amount of Rs.13,29,800/- from various investors and thereafter, failed to pay them back at the time of maturity of the amount as the applicant along with other accused persons running a company, IPN Developers.

Counsel for the applicant, at the outset, has submitted that the other co- accused persons have already been granted regular bail by this Court in M.Cr.C. Nos.3338/2023, 56727/2022 and Harisingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176512457/
1 57441/2022 vide order dated 31/01/2023 on their depositing a sum of Rs.4 Lakhs each as stated in the said order.

entities.text: Harisingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel has submitted that the applicant is also ready to deposit the aforesaid amount and thus, on the ground of parity, the application be also allowed and he be released on anticipatory bail.
Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that no case for anticipatory bail is made out.

O n due consideration of the rival submissions and perusal of the case diary as also the bail order dated 31/01/2023 of co-accused persons passed by this Court and the fact that the applicant is ready to deposit the amount, this Court is of the considered opinion that the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary in the present case.

Thus, without reflecting anything on the merits of the case, the application filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed subject to deposit a total sum of Rs.4,00,000/- (Rupees Four Lakh only), and the said amount shall be subject to the final outcome of the case by the trial Court.

It is directed that upon applicant's or any other person on his behalf depositing a sum of Rs.4,00,000/- (Rupees Four Lakhs only), out of which, Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh) at the time of furnishing the bail bond in a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and rest of Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakh) in three equal installments of Rs.1,00,000/- each within a period of three months from the date of his submitting bail bond in a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court, in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (rupees fifty thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).

The deposit receipt/certificate so produced by the applicant shall be endorsed by the learned Judge of the lower Court to be,
'furnished towards the bail of the applicant and shall be subject to the final decision of the case by the trial Court'.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE krjoshi Harisingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176512457/
